definitions.review_reason: For USEQ-FBE1B27D clause 1, the scanner first fixes the complete migration contract identity set. A pinned lossless schema then reads these exact typed members: source state, target state, dual operation period, negotiation rules, data conversion, key transition, validation evidence, stop conditions, retirement criteria. The closed predicate requires exact key coverage and proves that each named field is present for every independently inventoried subject with its declared raw type.
definitions.counterexample_analysis: An authenticated record could contain the other named content yet omit the migration stop conditions. The old generic category wrapper had no exact typed predicate for that omission and could report the record complete while the original promise remained false; the replacement explicitly requires this fact over the complete sealed inventory. In the executable negative case for USEQ-FBE1B27D clause 1, all unrelated fields stay valid while the input leaves the required source state empty; the predicate must return Fail.
